content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "Ground Moving Target Indicator (program element 1203155SF) is a U.S. Space Force research-and-development program funded in the Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation, Space Force account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "9d669d0dfceea781"}}, {"text": "The space-based Ground Moving Target Indicator (GMTI) project provides resources to acquire the next-generation radar satellite system, delivering resilient day-night, all-weather detection, tracking, and imagery of ground and maritime targets.", "citation": {"fact_id": "6967da05d0cb9a57"}}, {"text": "The project focuses on improving target detection, custody, and sensor-to-shooter timelines needed for dynamic targeting and long-range strike within highly contested and non-permissive environments, with the Space Force working alongside the military services, Combatant Commands, and the Intelligence Community.", "citation": {"fact_id": "6967da05d0cb9a57"}}, {"text": "The effort was previously carried under program element 1203154SF and sits in Budget Activity 7 (Operational System Development), the category used for development efforts that upgrade fielded systems or systems approved for full-rate production.", "citation": {"fact_id": "6967da05d0cb9a57"}}, {"text": "The work spans design, development, production, integration, test, on-orbit initialization, and mission execution for GMTI space vehicles and their vehicle-unique ground systems, with additional detail available under separate cover.", "citation": {"fact_id": "2144291ff69b37c1"}}, {"text": "Essentially all of the FY 2026 money flows through a single named project, Ground Moving Target Indicator (project 671120), funded at about $1,063.4 million for the budget year.", "citation": {"fact_id": "9f9fdcd6ef4f88be"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The program's total funding jumps from $256,000 thousand (about $256 million) in FY 2025 to $1,063,384 thousand (about $1.06 billion) requested for FY 2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "053912deff920435"}}, {"text": "That is a year-over-year increase of $807,384 thousand (about $807 million) from FY 2025 to FY 2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "d929b7e58afcdae8"}}, {"text": "The entire FY 2026 request is discretionary: the R-1 exhibit shows a $1,063,384 thousand discretionary request and no reconciliation (mandatory) request.", "citation": {"fact_id": "bc76bc9981cbdb12"}}, {"text": "The GMTI project's own line grows from $256.0 million in the current year to $1,063.4 million in the budget year, mirroring the program total as the effort scales up.", "citation": {"fact_id": "e17dfbd7300b7122"}}, {"text": "A Fiscal Receipts feed event flagged the program as increasing 315% from FY 2025 to FY 2026, one of the largest year-over-year swings in the Space Force portfolio.", "citation": {"fact_id": "d929b7e58afcdae8"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The program is run by the U.S. Space Force, with funding drawn from the Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation, Space Force appropriation.", "citation": {"fact_id": "b478fc8ae2d49c51"}}, {"text": "The Space Force is working collaboratively with the military services, Combatant Commands, and the Intelligence Community to deliver and field the GMTI capability, which was previously completed under program element 1203154SF.", "citation": {"fact_id": "6967da05d0cb9a57"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
